# Does this salary clear the overtime-exemption threshold?

> Free calculator for the 2026 FLSA white-collar overtime-exemption salary threshold — checks a weekly salary against the federal $684/week figure and the higher state threshold in California, Washington, New York, Maine, or Alaska, including New York's professional-exemption carve-out.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
